findings.currentTreatment: No sentence-description input, required-before-filing status or completion instruction. Only compliance yes/no is modeled.
findings.repairBoundary: Collect the actual sentence or require the participant to supply it in the application additional-information area or identified attachment; never invent it.

findings.currentTreatment: Counts include offense name/statute only; no class input or explicit participant handback.
findings.repairBoundary: Collect or explicitly require the participant to provide the actual class for each conviction, without inferring it from offense name.

findings.requiredFact: Date conditions were fulfilled and discharge status/date
findings.basis: AZ.memo.json az_set_aside participantInputs conditionsFulfilled (required), separate certificate timing
findings.currentTreatment: Judgment date is filled and compliance yes/no exists, but the distinct completion/discharge timing fact is not required or disclosed.
findings.repairBoundary: Collect the actual completion/discharge fact; judgment date is not its substitute.

findings.requiredFact: Whether the participant requests a certificate of second chance
findings.basis: AZ.memo.json az_set_aside participantInputs certificateRequested (required); Rule29.2(a) requested relief
findings.currentTreatment: The guide covers prior certificates and protects proposed-order certificate findings, but omits the participant request question and where to state it.
findings.repairBoundary: Ask the participant about the requested relief and record it in participant-authored application information. Do not turn the question into a judge-owned grant/deny, statutory eligibility, timing or one-certificate determination; court retains those decisions.
